# commander_enterprise_role (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `node` (String)

### Optional

- `enforcement_policies` (Map of String) Map of enforcement policies to apply to the role. The map key is the enforcement policy key (e.g., `REQUIRE_TWO_FACTOR`) and the value is the policy value (e.g., `"false"`).
- `managed_company` (String)
- `managing_nodes` (Attributes Map) Map of managing nodes with their privileges and cascade options. The map key is the node name/ID. Each managing node has `privileges` (optional) and `cascade` (optional) fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--managing_nodes))
- `teams` (Set of String)
- `users` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--managing_nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `managing_nodes`

Optional:

- `cascade` (Boolean) Whether to cascade privileges to child nodes.
- `privileges` (Set of String) Set of privileges to grant for this managing node. Valid values: `manage_nodes`, `manage_user`, `manage_roles`, `manage_teams`, `run_reports`, `manage_bridge`, `approve_device`, `manage_record_types`, `run_compliance_reports`, `transfer_account`, `sharing_administrator`
